blocks.zh: 第一章：品質管理
blocks.en: Chapter 1: Quality Management

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Chapter

blocks.zh: 理解 GDP 品質系統的四大構成要素：組織結構、程序、流程、資源，並能對照你的 CDMO 倉儲現況進行自評
blocks.en: Understand the four building blocks of a GDP quality system (organisational structure, procedures, processes and resources) and be able to self-assess your CDMO warehouse operation against them

blocks.zh: 掌握 Designated Responsible Person 的角色定位與法規意義
blocks.en: Understand the role and regulatory significance of the Designated Responsible Person

blocks.zh: 明確 Change Control、CAPA 在 GDP 品質系統中的必要性及其風險管理連結
blocks.en: Be clear on why change control and CAPA are necessary in a GDP quality system and how they link to risk management

blocks.zh: 了解委外活動管理的三個核心要求：評估適任性、定義責任分工、定期監控
blocks.en: Understand the three core requirements for managing outsourced activities: assess suitability, define responsibilities, and monitor periodically

blocks.zh: 掌握管理層定期審查 (Management Review) 的必要內容，並能識別哪些 KPI 屬於 GDP 系統績效指標
blocks.en: Know the required content of Management Review and be able to identify which KPIs are GDP system performance indicators

blocks.zh: 理解品質風險管理 (QRM) 在 GDP 中的系統化應用方式，並連結 ICH Q9 框架
blocks.en: Understand how quality risk management (QRM) is applied systematically in GDP, and link it to the ICH Q9 framework

blocks.zh: 1.1 Principle — 原則
blocks.en: 1.1 Principle

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：GDP 品質系統的三個基石
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Three Cornerstones of a GDP Quality System

blocks.zh: 1.1 原則段落濃縮了整個 Chapter 1 的精髓，可拆解為三個層次：
blocks.en: The 1.1 Principle paragraph distils the essence of the whole of Chapter 1. It can be broken down into three layers:

blocks.zh: 制度面 (Systemic)： 品質系統必須書面化責任分工與流程，不是口頭約定，也不是只有幾份 SOP 就算完成
blocks.en: Systemic: The quality system must document responsibilities and processes in writing. Verbal agreements do not count, and neither does simply having a handful of SOPs

blocks.zh: 風險面 (Risk-based)： 品質系統必須納入風險管理原則。這意味著你的 SOP 背後要有風險評估文件支撐關鍵決策
blocks.en: Risk-based: The quality system must incorporate risk management principles. This means the key decisions behind your SOPs should be supported by documented risk assessments

blocks.zh: 領導面 (Leadership-driven)： 品質系統不是 QA 部門的獨角戲，而是管理層的責任，需要最高管理層的領導與主動參與
blocks.en: Leadership-driven: The quality system is not a one-man show for the QA department. It is a management responsibility and requires the leadership and active participation of senior management

blocks.zh: 「Critical steps」的識別： 在 GDP 中，critical steps 通常包含：溫度敏感品的收貨檢查、冷藏倉的溫度監控、成品放行前的檔案核對、危險品隔離作業等。確認哪些步驟是 critical，是你建立 GDP 驗證計畫的起點。
blocks.en: Identifying "critical steps": In GDP, critical steps typically include: receipt inspection of temperature-sensitive products, temperature monitoring of cold storage, document checks before finished product release, and segregation of hazardous goods. Confirming which steps are critical is the starting point for building your GDP validation plan.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 將 GDP 品質系統比喻為一家星級飯店的服務品質體系。飯店老闆（管理層）必須親自制定服務標準（品質系統），並確保所有員工了解並遵守。如果只是把服務手冊印出來放在員工休息室，客人（患者）仍然可能拿到送錯溫度的餐點。
blocks.en: Think of the GDP quality system as the service quality system of a star-rated hotel. The hotel owner (management) must personally set the service standards (the quality system) and make sure every employee understands and follows them. If the service manual is merely printed and left in the staff lounge, guests (patients) may still be served a meal at the wrong temperature.

blocks.zh: 「Staff commitment（員工承諾）」這個詞刻意放入法規文字，代表 GDP 查廠時稽查員不只看文件，也會訪談作業人員，確認他們真的理解並落實程序。
blocks.en: The term "staff commitment" was deliberately placed in the regulatory text. It signals that in a GDP inspection, inspectors do not only look at documents; they also interview operators to confirm that they truly understand and apply the procedures.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Note
blocks.en: Key Note

blocks.zh: 驗證（Validation）在 GDP 中的範疇： GDP 的 validation 主要針對倉儲與配送流程，不是製造流程。例如：冷藏倉庫的溫度分布測試 (temperature mapping)、冷鏈配送路線的驗證、包裝系統的保溫效能測試。這些驗證需要有計畫、有報告、有放行核准，和 GMP 驗證邏輯一致，但對象不同。
blocks.en: The scope of validation in GDP: Validation in GDP mainly targets warehousing and distribution processes, not manufacturing processes. Examples include temperature mapping of cold storage, qualification of cold chain distribution routes, and thermal performance testing of packaging systems. These activities need a plan, a report and approval for release, following the same logic as GMP validation but applied to different subjects.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 在你的 CDMO 倉儲作業中，哪三項步驟你認為屬於 GDP 定義下的「critical steps」？你目前有對這些步驟進行正式的驗證嗎？
blocks.en: In your CDMO warehouse operation, which three steps do you consider to be "critical steps" as defined under GDP? Have you formally validated these steps?

blocks.zh: 若稽查員問：「請說明貴公司管理層如何主動參與 GDP 品質系統的運作？」你會如何回答？能提供哪些具體的文件證據？
blocks.en: If an inspector asks, "Please explain how your management actively participates in the operation of the GDP quality system," how would you answer? What concrete documented evidence could you provide?

blocks.zh: 1.2 Quality System — 品質系統
blocks.en: 1.2 Quality System

blocks.zh: 核心概念：GDP 品質系統的四大構成元素
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Four Elements of a GDP Quality System

blocks.zh: 1.2.1 明確列出品質系統的四大組成：
blocks.en: 1.2.1 explicitly lists the four components of a quality system:

blocks.zh: Organisational structure（組織架構）： 誰負責什麼？權責是否清楚書面化？
blocks.en: Organisational structure: Who is responsible for what? Are authorities and responsibilities clearly documented?

blocks.zh: Procedures（程序）： SOP 體系是否完整涵蓋所有配送活動？
blocks.en: Procedures: Does the SOP system fully cover all distribution activities?

blocks.zh: Processes（流程）： 實際作業流程是否與 SOP 一致並有效監控？
blocks.en: Processes: Are actual operating processes consistent with the SOPs and effectively monitored?

blocks.zh: Resources（資源）： 人員能力、設施設備、系統工具是否充足？
blocks.en: Resources: Are personnel competence, facilities, equipment and system tools adequate?

blocks.zh: Quality Manual（品質手冊）： 1.2.2 要求建立品質手冊或等效文件。對大型 CDMO 而言，這通常是一份描述整個品質管理體系架構的頂層文件，下層連結各 SOP 與工作指引。「或等效方式」代表純數位文件管理系統也被接受，只要結構清晰可查。
blocks.en: Quality Manual: 1.2.2 requires a quality manual or equivalent documentation. For a large CDMO, this is usually a top-level document describing the architecture of the whole quality management system, linking down to the individual SOPs and work instructions. "Or equivalent" means that a purely electronic document management system is also acceptable, as long as its structure is clear and traceable.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Designated Responsible Person（指定負責人）
blocks.en: Key Concept: Designated Responsible Person

blocks.zh: 1.2.3 要求正式指派一位或多位具有清楚職權的負責人，負責確保品質系統的實施與維護。這個角色在 GDP 中的地位類似 GMP 中的 Qualified Person (QP) 或台灣 GMP 制度中的品質主管。
blocks.en: 1.2.3 requires the formal appointment of one or more persons with clear authority who are responsible for ensuring that the quality system is implemented and maintained. In GDP, this role is comparable to the Qualified Person (QP) in GMP, or to the head of quality in Taiwan's GMP system.

blocks.zh: 關鍵問題： 這個人的職責必須以書面指定，且不能只是名義上的頭銜。稽查時，稽查員會詢問這個人具體做了哪些工作來確保品質系統有效運作。
blocks.en: Key point: The person's responsibilities must be designated in writing, and the role cannot be a title in name only. During an inspection, the inspector will ask what this person has specifically done to ensure that the quality system works effectively.

blocks.zh: CDMO 常見盲點： 許多 CDMO 在 GMP 部分有完整的 QA 組織，但 GDP（倉儲配送）的負責人往往是倉儲主管而非 QA 背景人員，可能導致品質系統的品質視角不足。
blocks.en: Common CDMO blind spot: Many CDMOs have a complete QA organisation for GMP, but the person responsible for GDP (warehousing and distribution) is often the warehouse manager rather than someone with a QA background. This can leave the quality system lacking a quality perspective.

blocks.zh: 1.2.5 比例原則（Proportionality）的意義： 這就像選擇消防設備 — 一間小辦公室裝幾個滅火器就夠了，但一座大型倉儲設施需要整套自動灑水系統和消防管理計畫。GDP 品質系統的規模和複雜度應該與你的業務規模相稱，不需要過度設計，但也不能用過於簡陋的系統應付複雜的業務。
blocks.en: What proportionality means (1.2.5): It is like choosing fire protection equipment. A few fire extinguishers are enough for a small office, but a large warehouse facility needs a full automatic sprinkler system and a fire management plan. The scale and complexity of your GDP quality system should be commensurate with the size of your business. It need not be over-engineered, but a rudimentary system should not be used to cover a complex operation.

blocks.zh: 1.2.7(iii) 「Right recipients within satisfactory time」： 這對 CDMO 的冷鏈業務特別重要。藥品送對了人、但溫度飄移超標，或者送對了溫度、但送錯了地點，都是 GDP 偏差。
blocks.en: 1.2.7(iii) "Right recipients within a satisfactory time": This is especially important for the CDMO's cold chain business. Delivering medicines to the right recipient but with a temperature excursion beyond limits, or at the right temperature but to the wrong location, are both GDP deviations.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Contemporaneous Records（同步記錄）的法規意義
blocks.en: Key Note: The Regulatory Significance of Contemporaneous Records

blocks.zh: 1.2.7(iv) 的「contemporaneously（同步記錄）」是一個法規關鍵詞。它意味著：
blocks.en: "Contemporaneously" in 1.2.7(iv) is a key regulatory term. It means that:

blocks.zh: 記錄必須在活動發生的當時或立即後填寫，不能事後補填
blocks.en: Records must be completed at the time the activity takes place or immediately afterwards, and must not be back-filled later

blocks.zh: 電子系統的時間戳記 (timestamp) 必須可靠，不能被輕易修改
blocks.en: The timestamps of electronic systems must be reliable and must not be easily altered

blocks.zh: 如果記錄是事後補填，即使內容正確，在稽查中也是重大缺失（屬於 21 CFR Part 11 的數據完整性問題）
blocks.en: If records are back-filled, even if the content is correct, it is a major finding in an inspection (a data integrity issue, as addressed by 21 CFR Part 11)

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 倉儲而言，這要求所有出入庫記錄、溫度監控記錄、偏差記錄必須即時完成，而非每日或每班彙整。
blocks.en: For CDMO warehousing, this means that all goods-in/goods-out records, temperature monitoring records and deviation records must be completed in real time, not compiled daily or per shift.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 正在準備 TFDA GDP 稽查。稽查員要求查看你的 GDP Change Control 系統記錄。
blocks.en: Your CDMO is preparing for a TFDA GDP inspection. The inspector asks to see the records of your GDP change control system.

blocks.zh: 根據 1.2.6，你需要展示：(1) Change Control SOP 的存在與版本歷史；(2) 近一年內至少一個實際完成的 change control 案例（例如：更換冷藏倉的溫度記錄設備）；(3) 這個變更如何進行風險評估，以及如何決定是否需要重新驗證。若你的 CDMO 過去一年完全沒有 change control 記錄，稽查員可能會質疑你的品質系統是否有真正運作。
blocks.en: Under 1.2.6, you need to demonstrate: (1) the existence of a change control SOP and its version history; (2) at least one change control case actually completed within the past year (for example, replacing the temperature recording equipment of a cold store); (3) how risk assessment was performed for this change and how the decision on whether revalidation was needed was made. If your CDMO has no change control records at all for the past year, the inspector may question whether your quality system is genuinely operating.

blocks.zh: 1.2.7 列出六項品質系統必須確保的事項。對你的 CDMO 倉儲操作，請各舉一個具體的 SOP 或程序來對應每一項。
blocks.en: 1.2.7 lists six matters that the quality system must ensure. For your CDMO warehouse operation, give one specific SOP or procedure that corresponds to each of them.

blocks.zh: 若你的 CDMO 同時有 GMP 的 Designated Person 和 GDP 的 Designated Responsible Person，這兩個角色可以是同一人嗎？各有哪些優缺點？
blocks.en: If your CDMO has both a GMP Designated Person and a GDP Designated Responsible Person, can these two roles be held by the same person? What are the advantages and disadvantages of each approach?

blocks.zh: 「比例原則（proportionate）」在實務上如何應用？一家小型 CDMO（年配送量少於 100 批次）和大型 CDMO（年配送量超過 1000 批次）的 GDP 品質系統規模差異應在哪些地方體現？
blocks.en: How is "proportionate" applied in practice? Where should the difference in GDP quality system scale be reflected between a small CDMO (fewer than 100 distributed batches per year) and a large CDMO (more than 1,000 distributed batches per year)?

blocks.zh: 1.3 Management of Outsourced Activities — 委外活動管理
blocks.en: 1.3 Management of Outsourced Activities

blocks.zh: 核心概念：委外不等於責任轉移
blocks.en: Key Concept: Outsourcing Does Not Transfer Responsibility

blocks.zh: 1.3 的核心訊息是：你可以委外，但你不能委外你的責任。
blocks.en: The core message of 1.3 is: you can outsource activities, but you cannot outsource your responsibility.

blocks.zh: 當 CDMO 將冷鏈運輸委託給第三方物流商（3PL），GDP 的責任並沒有從 CDMO 轉移到 3PL。CDMO 仍然必須確保 3PL 具備能力、有適當的程序，並定期監控其表現。
blocks.en: When a CDMO outsources cold chain transportation to a third-party logistics provider (3PL), GDP responsibility is not transferred from the CDMO to the 3PL. The CDMO must still ensure that the 3PL is competent, has appropriate procedures, and is monitored periodically for its performance.

blocks.zh: 三個委外管理要求：
blocks.en: Three requirements for managing outsourced activities:

blocks.zh: 事前評估 (Prior Assessment)： 委外前必須評估 Contract Acceptor 的資格與能力（即供應商資格審核 / Vendor Qualification）
blocks.en: Prior Assessment: Before outsourcing, the qualifications and capability of the Contract Acceptor must be assessed (i.e. vendor qualification / supplier qualification audit)

blocks.zh: 合約定義 (Contractual Definition)： 以書面明確各方的品質責任與溝通機制（即 Quality Agreement / Technical Agreement）
blocks.en: Contractual Definition: The quality responsibilities and communication mechanisms of each party must be clearly defined in writing (i.e. a Quality Agreement / Technical Agreement)

blocks.zh: 持續監控 (Ongoing Monitoring)： 定期審查 Contract Acceptor 的實際表現，發現問題時需有改善行動
blocks.en: Ongoing Monitoring: The actual performance of the Contract Acceptor must be reviewed periodically, with improvement actions taken when problems are found

blocks.zh: 委外關係就像裝修工程的「總包 - 分包」關係。業主（CDMO 的客戶）把工程包給總包商（CDMO），但如果分包商（3PL）出了問題，業主還是會找總包商負責。
blocks.en: Outsourcing is like the main contractor - subcontractor relationship in a renovation project. The owner (the CDMO's customer) awards the work to the main contractor (the CDMO), but if a subcontractor (the 3PL) causes a problem, the owner will still hold the main contractor accountable.

blocks.zh: 因此，CDMO 作為「總包商」必須：(1) 仔細選擇分包商（供應商審核）；(2) 在合約中明確哪些工作是誰的責任（品質協議）；(3) 定期到工地查看分包商的施工品質（定期稽核 / KPI 監控）。
blocks.en: Therefore, the CDMO as the "main contractor" must: (1) select subcontractors carefully (supplier audit); (2) state in the contract who is responsible for what (quality agreement); (3) inspect the subcontractor's workmanship on site periodically (periodic audits / KPI monitoring).

blocks.zh: 重點提示：3PL 稽核的 GDP 必要性
blocks.en: Key Note: Why 3PL Audits Are Essential in GDP

blocks.zh: 許多 CDMO 對 3PL 供應商的管理停留在「簽了合約就沒事」的階段。根據 1.3(iii)，你需要定期（通常每年或每兩年）對 3PL 進行：
blocks.en: Many CDMOs manage their 3PL suppliers only to the stage of "once the contract is signed, we are fine". Under 1.3(iii), you need to perform the following on the 3PL periodically (usually every year or every two years):

blocks.zh: 文件審查： GDP 許可的有效性、SOP 版本、溫度監控記錄
blocks.en: Document review: Validity of the GDP licence, SOP versions, temperature monitoring records

blocks.zh: 現場稽核： 倉儲環境、溫度記錄設備、人員訓練記錄
blocks.en: On-site audit: Storage environment, temperature recording equipment, personnel training records

blocks.zh: KPI 回顧： 配送準時率、溫度偏差事件數、客訴頻率
blocks.en: KPI review: On-time delivery rate, number of temperature excursion events, complaint frequency

blocks.zh: 稽查員會要求查看你最近一次對 3PL 的稽核報告及後續 CAPA 執行記錄。
blocks.en: Inspectors will ask to see your most recent audit report on the 3PL and the follow-up CAPA implementation records.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 使用一家 3PL 廠商（甲方）承接所有成品的台灣境內配送，另一家冷鏈專業公司（乙方）承接出口到東南亞的國際段冷鏈。
blocks.en: Your CDMO uses one 3PL provider (Party A) for all domestic finished product distribution in Taiwan, and another specialist cold chain company (Party B) for the international cold chain leg for export to Southeast Asia.

blocks.zh: 根據 1.3，你的 GDP 品質系統應涵蓋：(1) 對甲乙兩方各自建立供應商評估檔案（含 GDP 許可確認）；(2) 與甲乙兩方分別簽訂品質技術協議，明確溫度偏差的報告義務、調查責任分工；(3) 建立年度稽核計畫，對甲乙兩方輪流執行現場稽核；(4) 建立月度 KPI 報表，追蹤兩方的配送績效。若其中一方表現不佳，你的系統需要有正式的改善計畫啟動機制。
blocks.en: Under 1.3, your GDP quality system should cover: (1) a separate supplier assessment file for each of Party A and Party B (including confirmation of the GDP licence); (2) separate quality/technical agreements with each, clearly defining the obligation to report temperature excursions and the division of investigation responsibilities; (3) an annual audit plan with on-site audits of A and B in rotation; (4) a monthly KPI report tracking the distribution performance of both parties. If one party performs poorly, your system needs a formal mechanism to initiate an improvement plan.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 目前委外了哪些配送相關活動？這些活動是否都有對應的品質技術協議？協議中是否明確了溫度偏差的責任歸屬？
blocks.en: Which distribution-related activities does your CDMO currently outsource? Is there a corresponding quality/technical agreement for each of them? Does the agreement clearly assign responsibility for temperature excursions?

blocks.zh: 若稽查員詢問：「你們如何確認第三方物流公司具備承接貴公司產品（需 2–8°C 冷鏈）的資格？」你有哪些文件可以出示？
blocks.en: If an inspector asks, "How do you confirm that the third-party logistics company is qualified to handle your products (which require a 2–8°C cold chain)?", what documents can you present?

blocks.zh: 「checking authorisation or marketing status」這個要求的背景是什麼？它與防止假藥的目的有何關係？
blocks.en: What is the background to the requirement of "checking authorisation or marketing status"? How does it relate to the aim of preventing falsified medicines?

blocks.zh: 1.4 Management Review and Monitoring — 管理層審查與監控
blocks.en: 1.4 Management Review and Monitoring

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Management Review 的五大審查面向
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Five Areas of Management Review

blocks.zh: GDP 的管理審查不是走形式的年度會議，而是一個需要涵蓋五個面向的系統性評估：
blocks.en: A GDP management review is not a perfunctory annual meeting. It is a systematic evaluation that needs to cover five areas:

blocks.zh: 目標達成度： 你設定的 GDP 品質目標（如：溫度偏差率低於 X%）今年達到了嗎？
blocks.en: Achievement of objectives: Did you meet the GDP quality objectives you set (e.g. a temperature excursion rate below X%) this year?

blocks.zh: 績效指標 (KPIs)： 投訴、召回、退貨、偏差、CAPA、委外活動、自我評估、外部稽查
blocks.en: Performance indicators (KPIs): Complaints, recalls, returns, deviations, CAPA, outsourced activities, self-assessments, external audits

blocks.zh: 法規動態： 今年有沒有新的 GDP 指引或 TFDA 函釋影響你的系統？
blocks.en: Regulatory developments: Have any new GDP guidelines or TFDA interpretations this year affected your system?

blocks.zh: 創新機會： 有沒有新技術或新方法可以強化你的品質系統？
blocks.en: Innovation opportunities: Are there new technologies or methods that could strengthen your quality system?

blocks.zh: 業務環境變化： 你的客戶群、產品線、配送地區是否有重大變化影響 GDP 系統的設計？
blocks.en: Changes in the business environment: Have there been major changes in your customer base, product lines or distribution regions that affect the design of the GDP system?

blocks.zh: Management Review 就像汽車的年度健檢加上里程碑保養。不只是看引擎有沒有壞（偏差），還要看輪胎磨損程度（長期趨勢）、確認保養記錄完整（文件）、了解今年有沒有新的車輛安全法規（法規動態），並考慮是否要升級導航系統（創新）。
blocks.en: Management Review is like an annual vehicle inspection combined with a mileage-based service. It is not only about checking whether the engine is broken (deviations), but also about the degree of tyre wear (long-term trends), confirming that service records are complete (documentation), learning whether new vehicle safety regulations have been introduced this year (regulatory developments), and considering whether to upgrade the navigation system (innovation).

blocks.zh: 「Timely manner（及時記錄）」呼應了 1.2.7(iv) 的同步記錄要求。管理審查的結論不能開完會就忘了，必須有文件記錄且對內溝通。稽查員經常要求查閱最近一次管理審查的會議記錄和後續行動項目追蹤。
blocks.en: "Timely manner" echoes the contemporaneous recording requirement in 1.2.7(iv). The conclusions of a management review must not be forgotten once the meeting ends. They must be documented and communicated internally. Inspectors often ask to see the minutes of the most recent management review and the follow-up tracking of action items.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Management Review vs. CAPA Review 的區別
blocks.en: Key Note: Management Review vs. CAPA Review

blocks.zh: 新手常混淆的兩個概念：
blocks.en: Two concepts that newcomers often confuse:

blocks.zh: CAPA Review（個別事件層次）： 針對單一偏差或投訴的矯正預防行動，是日常品質管理的工作
blocks.en: CAPA Review (individual event level): Corrective and preventive actions for a single deviation or complaint, part of day-to-day quality management

blocks.zh: Management Review（系統層次）： 評估整個品質系統的整體健康狀況，是管理層領導力的展現
blocks.en: Management Review (system level): An evaluation of the overall health of the entire quality system, demonstrating management leadership

blocks.zh: Management Review 需要把所有 CAPA 的趨勢整合起來看：「過去一年我們有 12 個溫度偏差事件，集中在夏季，且都發生在同一條配送路線 — 這是否代表我們的冷鏈包裝設計需要調整？」這才是管理審查應該回答的問題。
blocks.en: Management Review needs to bring together the trends from all CAPAs: "Over the past year we had 12 temperature excursion events, concentrated in summer and all on the same distribution route. Does this mean our cold chain packaging design needs to be adjusted?" This is the kind of question a management review should answer.

blocks.zh: 你正在準備年度 GDP Management Review 的投影片，需要對最高管理層報告。根據 1.4.1，你的投影片應至少涵蓋：
blocks.en: You are preparing the slides for the annual GDP Management Review to report to senior management. Under 1.4.1, your slides should cover at least:

blocks.zh: 年度 GDP KPIs 達成情況（溫度偏差次數、投訴件數、偏差結案率）
blocks.en: Achievement of annual GDP KPIs (number of temperature excursions, number of complaints, deviation closure rate)

blocks.zh: 今年完成的稽核（供應商稽核 + 內部稽核）及主要發現
blocks.en: Audits completed this year (supplier audits and internal audits) and the main findings

blocks.zh: CAPA 完成率及開放中項目的風險評估
blocks.en: CAPA completion rate and risk assessment of open items

blocks.zh: 今年影響 GDP 的法規變化（如 TFDA 新公告、PIC/S 更新）
blocks.en: Regulatory changes affecting GDP this year (e.g. new TFDA announcements, PIC/S updates)

blocks.zh: 明年品質目標與改善計畫提案
blocks.en: Proposed quality objectives and improvement plans for next year

blocks.zh: 這份報告必須有管理層的正式簽核，且後續行動項目需指定負責人與完成期限。
blocks.en: This report must be formally approved by management, and the follow-up action items must have an assigned owner and a due date.

blocks.zh: 列出五個你認為最能反映你的 CDMO 配送品質的 GDP KPIs，並說明如何收集這些數據。
blocks.en: List five GDP KPIs that you think best reflect the distribution quality of your CDMO, and explain how you would collect the data.

blocks.zh: 若今年的管理審查發現某 3PL 的溫度偏差率比去年增加了 50%，管理層應採取哪些具體行動？這些行動應如何記錄？
blocks.en: If this year's management review finds that a 3PL's temperature excursion rate has increased by 50% compared with last year, what specific actions should management take? How should these actions be documented?

blocks.zh: 「Changes in business environment and objectives」這個審查項目，對一家業務快速擴張中的 CDMO（例如新增了 mRNA 疫苗產品線）有什麼特別的意義？
blocks.en: What special significance does the review item "Changes in business environment and objectives" have for a rapidly expanding CDMO (for example, one that has added an mRNA vaccine product line)?

blocks.zh: 1.5 Quality Risk Management — 品質風險管理
blocks.en: 1.5 Quality Risk Management

blocks.zh: 核心概念：QRM 的四個步驟與雙向應用
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Four Steps of QRM and Its Two-Way Application

blocks.zh: 根據 1.5.1，品質風險管理包含四個步驟，與 ICH Q9 框架完全一致：
blocks.en: According to 1.5.1, quality risk management comprises four steps, fully consistent with the ICH Q9 framework:

blocks.zh: Assessment（評估）： 識別風險，評估其可能性 (probability) 與嚴重性 (severity)
blocks.en: Assessment: Identify risks and evaluate their probability and severity

blocks.zh: Control（控制）： 決定降低風險的措施（如：增加溫度監控頻率、改用隔熱容器）
blocks.en: Control: Decide on measures to reduce risk (e.g. increase the frequency of temperature monitoring, switch to insulated containers)

blocks.zh: Communication（溝通）： 將風險評估結果傳達給相關利害關係人（管理層、客戶、監管機構）
blocks.en: Communication: Communicate the results of the risk assessment to relevant stakeholders (management, customers, regulators)

blocks.zh: Review（回顧）： 定期重新評估風險，確認控制措施有效
blocks.en: Review: Re-evaluate risks periodically and confirm that the control measures are effective

blocks.zh: 雙向應用：
blocks.en: Two-way application:

blocks.zh: Proactive（前瞻）： 在導入新配送路線或新 3PL 之前，先做風險評估
blocks.en: Proactive: Perform a risk assessment before introducing a new distribution route or a new 3PL

blocks.zh: Retrospective（回溯）： 發生溫度偏差後，用 QRM 分析根本原因並評估對產品的影響
blocks.en: Retrospective: After a temperature excursion, use QRM to analyse the root cause and assess the impact on the product

blocks.zh: 核心概念：ICH Q9 在 GDP 中的應用工具
blocks.en: Key Concept: ICH Q9 Tools Applied in GDP

blocks.zh: 1.5.2 明確引用 ICH Q9，代表 GDP 的 QRM 應遵循同一套方法論框架。常用於 GDP 的 ICH Q9 風險評估工具：
blocks.en: 1.5.2 explicitly refers to ICH Q9, meaning that QRM in GDP should follow the same methodological framework. ICH Q9 risk assessment tools commonly used in GDP include:

blocks.zh: FMEA（Failure Mode and Effects Analysis，失效模式與影響分析）： 適用於分析配送流程中每個環節的潛在失效（如：冷藏車故障、司機交接失誤），評估 RPN 值
blocks.en: FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis): Suited to analysing potential failures at each step of the distribution process (e.g. refrigerated vehicle breakdown, driver handover errors) and evaluating the RPN value

blocks.zh: HACCP（Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points）： 在食品安全領域發展成熟，GDP 的冷鏈管理可借用此框架識別關鍵控制點
blocks.en: HACCP (Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points): Well established in food safety; GDP cold chain management can borrow this framework to identify critical control points

blocks.zh: Fishbone（魚骨圖）： 適用於偏差調查，識別溫度偏差的根本原因（人機料法環）
blocks.en: Fishbone (Ishikawa diagram): Suited to deviation investigations, to identify the root causes of temperature excursions (man, machine, material, method, environment)

blocks.zh: 「Commensurate with the level of risk」的實務意涵： 這就像選擇保險的邏輯。一個小螺絲鬆掉（低風險）你用六角板手鎖緊就好，不需要叫設備工程師寫正式偏差報告。但如果是冷藏壓縮機異音（高風險），就必須立即啟動正式評估、找廠商維修並寫偏差報告。
blocks.en: Practical meaning of "commensurate with the level of risk": This is like the logic of choosing insurance. If a small screw comes loose (low risk), you simply tighten it with a hex key and do not need to ask an equipment engineer to write a formal deviation report. But if a refrigeration compressor makes an abnormal noise (high risk), you must immediately start a formal assessment, call in a contractor for repair and write a deviation report.

blocks.zh: QRM 讓你的品質系統更有效率：把精力放在真正重要的風險上，而不是對所有事情一律採用最高規格的調查程序。這也是為什麼「effort, formality and documentation should be commensurate with risk」這句話在 GMP/GDP 框架中反覆出現。
blocks.en: QRM makes your quality system more efficient: it puts effort into the risks that really matter, rather than applying the highest-grade investigation procedure to everything. This is also why the phrase "effort, formality and documentation should be commensurate with risk" appears repeatedly in GMP/GDP frameworks.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：GDP 中最常見的風險評估場景
blocks.en: Key Note: The Most Common Risk Assessment Scenarios in GDP

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的 GDP 實務中，以下情境需要啟動正式 QRM：
blocks.en: In CDMO GDP practice, the following situations call for formal QRM:

blocks.zh: 新 3PL 導入： 評估其 GDP 資格、設施條件、歷史偏差記錄
blocks.en: Introducing a new 3PL: Assess its GDP qualification, facility conditions and deviation history

blocks.zh: 新配送路線： 評估路途時間、溫控風險、最差條件（夏季高溫、運輸延誤）
blocks.en: New distribution route: Assess transit time, temperature control risks and worst-case conditions (summer heat, transport delays)

blocks.zh: 溫度偏差調查： 評估偏差對產品品質的潛在影響，決定是否可放行或需要召回
blocks.en: Temperature excursion investigation: Assess the potential impact of the excursion on product quality and decide whether the product can be released or a recall is needed

blocks.zh: 季節性風險： 台灣夏季高溫對冷鏈配送的特殊挑戰（環境溫度可達 35°C 以上）
blocks.en: Seasonal risk: The particular challenge of Taiwan's summer heat for cold chain distribution (ambient temperatures can exceed 35°C)

blocks.zh: 停電或設備故障： 冷藏倉停電後，庫存產品的品質影響評估
blocks.en: Power outage or equipment failure: Assess the quality impact on stored product after a power outage in a cold store

blocks.zh: 場景：你的 CDMO 計畫在今年夏天首次出貨一批 2–8°C 的單株抗體原液（DS）至新加坡，全程需要 14 小時（台灣廠出貨 → 桃園機場 → 新加坡樟宜機場 → 客戶倉庫）。
blocks.en: Scenario: This summer, your CDMO plans to ship a batch of 2–8°C monoclonal antibody drug substance (DS) to Singapore for the first time. The entire journey takes 14 hours (Taiwan site dispatch → Taoyuan Airport → Singapore Changi Airport → customer warehouse).

blocks.zh: 根據 1.5 的 QRM 框架，你應在出貨前執行：
blocks.en: Under the QRM framework in 1.5, you should carry out the following before shipment:

blocks.zh: 風險評估： 使用 FMEA 識別各段潛在失效（如：過境檢查延誤導致在機場停留超過 4 小時、冷藏集裝箱乾冰量不足）
blocks.en: Risk assessment: Use FMEA to identify potential failures in each leg (e.g. customs clearance delays leaving the shipment at the airport for more than 4 hours, insufficient dry ice in the refrigerated container)

blocks.zh: 控制措施： 要求航空公司提供優先過境服務、選用乾冰用量經過驗證的保溫容器、在容器內放置數據記錄器
blocks.en: Control measures: Ask the airline for priority transit service, use insulated containers with validated dry ice quantities, and place a data logger in the container

blocks.zh: 溝通： 在出貨前與客戶確認接收程序，並告知偏差的處理方式
blocks.en: Communication: Confirm receiving procedures with the customer before shipment and inform them how deviations will be handled

blocks.zh: 回顧： 收貨後審查數據記錄器的溫度曲線，確認全程符合規格，並將結果納入你的 GDP 品質記錄
blocks.en: Review: After receipt, review the temperature profile from the data logger to confirm that the whole journey met the specification, and include the results in your GDP quality records

blocks.zh: 「Protection of the patient」是 QRM 的最終目的。在 GDP 的語境中（距離患者有好幾個環節），你如何向倉儲操作人員解釋他們的工作與患者安全的直接關聯？
blocks.en: "Protection of the patient" is the ultimate purpose of QRM. In the GDP context, where there are several steps between you and the patient, how would you explain to warehouse operators the direct link between their work and patient safety?

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 只有一位 QA 人員負責 GDP，你會如何優先排序 QRM 工作，確保有限資源放在最重要的風險控制上？
blocks.en: If your CDMO has only one QA person responsible for GDP, how would you prioritise QRM work to ensure that limited resources go to the most important risk controls?

blocks.zh: ICH Q9(R1) 是 Q9 的修訂版（2023 年發布）。這個修訂版強化了 QRM 的哪些面向？這對你的 GDP QRM 實施有什麼影響？（提示：可從 ICH Q9(R1) 關於主觀性、formality 的強調出發思考）
blocks.en: ICH Q9(R1) is the revised version of Q9 (published in 2023). Which aspects of QRM does this revision strengthen? What does this mean for implementing QRM in your GDP system? (Hint: start from ICH Q9(R1)'s emphasis on subjectivity and formality.)

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 1.1 原則： GDP 品質系統必須涵蓋責任分工、流程程序與風險管理原則；管理層須承擔領導責任，不能只靠 QA 部門
blocks.en: 1.1 Principle: The GDP quality system must cover the allocation of responsibilities, processes and procedures, and risk management principles; management must take leadership responsibility and cannot rely on the QA department alone

blocks.zh: 1.2 品質系統： 四大構成要素（組織、程序、流程、資源）必須全部書面化且受監控；Designated Responsible Person 須正式指派且具清楚職權；Change Control 和 CAPA 是品質系統不可或缺的組成
blocks.en: 1.2 Quality System: The four elements (organisation, procedures, processes, resources) must all be documented and monitored; the Designated Responsible Person must be formally appointed with clear authority; change control and CAPA are indispensable components of the quality system

blocks.zh: 1.3 委外管理： 委外不轉移責任；必須評估 Contract Acceptor 資格、以書面定義責任分工、定期監控其表現；對 3PL 的稽核是 GDP 合規的核心工作
blocks.en: 1.3 Outsourced Activities: Outsourcing does not transfer responsibility; the Contract Acceptor must be assessed, responsibilities defined in writing, and performance monitored periodically; auditing the 3PL is a core task of GDP compliance

blocks.zh: 1.4 管理審查： 定期審查須涵蓋五個面向（KPI、法規動態、創新、業務變化、目標達成）；結論必須及時記錄並對內溝通
blocks.en: 1.4 Management Review: Periodic review must cover five areas (KPIs, regulatory developments, innovation, business changes, achievement of objectives); conclusions must be documented in a timely manner and communicated internally

blocks.zh: 1.5 品質風險管理： QRM 是 GDP 的底層邏輯，遵循 ICH Q9 框架；可前瞻或回溯應用；努力程度與風險高低成比例；最終目的是保護患者
blocks.en: 1.5 Quality Risk Management: QRM is the underlying logic of GDP and follows the ICH Q9 framework; it can be applied proactively or retrospectively; the level of effort is proportionate to the level of risk; the ultimate purpose is to protect the patient

blocks.zh: CDMO 關鍵啟示： 台灣 CDMO 的 GDP 品質系統不能只是 GMP 系統的附加項目，而是需要針對倉儲、冷鏈、委外物流的特性獨立設計，並確保有足夠資源投入
blocks.en: Key takeaway for CDMOs: A Taiwan CDMO's GDP quality system cannot be a mere add-on to its GMP system. It needs to be designed independently for the characteristics of warehousing, cold chain and outsourced logistics, with sufficient resources committed
